<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/post-split.ts -->
<!--
  A post header with the author, the reading figures, the tags and the actions. Axes: layout (center: tags,
  figures and an author card with share and save over a wide cover; split: beside the cover; outline: facts and
  related reading beside the cover), mediaSide, author (line, card, bio), cover (wide, square), actions (pair,
  wide, icons), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { PostExtras, PostSplitLabels } from "./post-split.types";
import type { Post } from "./post-card.types";
import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";

export type PostSplitProps = {
  id: string;
  post: Post;
  labels: PostSplitLabels;
  extras: PostExtras;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  layout?: "center" | "split" | "outline";
  mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
  author?: "line" | "card" | "bio";
  cover?: "wide" | "square";
  actions?: "pair" | "wide" | "icons";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import PostActions from "../components/post-actions.vue";
import PostAuthor from "../components/post-author.vue";
import PostOutline from "../components/post-outline.vue";
import PostStats from "../components/post-stats.vue";
import PostTags from "../components/post-tags.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  post,
  labels,
  extras,
  level = 1,
  layout = "split",
  mediaSide = "end",
  author = "line",
  cover = "wide",
  actions = "pair",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<PostSplitProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame v-if="((layout as string) === 'center')"
    :id="id"
    :title="post.title"
    :lead="post.excerpt"
    :heading="{ badge: post.category, level }"
    :tone="tone"
    :media="{ show: true }"
    align="center"
  >
    <PostTags :tags="extras.tags" align="center" />
    <PostStats :post="post" :extras="extras" :labels="labels" align="center" />
    <PostAuthor
      :post="post"
      :extras="extras"
      :labels="labels"
      mode="card"
      :share="true"
      class="mx-auto w-full max-w-md"
    />
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame
        :alt="post.title"
        :ratio="
          (layout as string) === 'center' ? '21/9'
          : (cover as string) === 'square' ? '1/1'
          : '4/3'
        "
      />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-else
    :id="id"
    :title="post.title"
    :lead="post.excerpt"
    :heading="{ badge: post.category, level }"
    :tone="tone"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide }"
    layout="split"
  >
    <PostOutline v-if="((layout as string) === 'outline')" :post="post" :extras="extras" :labels="labels" />
    <template v-else>
      <PostAuthor :post="post" :extras="extras" :labels="labels" :mode="author" />
      <PostStats v-if="((author as string) !== 'line')" :post="post" :extras="extras" :labels="labels" />
      <PostTags :tags="extras.tags" align="start" />
    </template>
    <PostActions :labels="labels" :mode="actions" />
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame
        :alt="post.title"
        :ratio="
          (layout as string) === 'center' ? '21/9'
          : (cover as string) === 'square' ? '1/1'
          : '4/3'
        "
      />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
